practicalAssessorReference: Isolation: hasp and personnel lock before entering the footprint; visually confirm the boarding ladder lifts as a backup to the interlock.
Access/egress: three points of contact at all times.
Start-up: do not idle more than 20 minutes; horn twice before moving off.
Moving off: 40m exclusion zone clear; blade raised ~400mm; ripper raised to full height; park brake released only after all safety checks pass.
Downhill travel: transmission preselected to 4th gear or lower for engine-assisted braking; never descend in 5th gear or higher.
Ripper: apply differential lock first; do not use the ripper while turning or articulating.
Mouldboard: usually angled at 75 degrees from the centreline; tilt forward for aggressive cutting, backward to carry material.
Crowning: standard road crown 3%, standard cross fall/super elevation 8%.

Float loading: spotter positions between goose neck and float access step; isolate with lock and hasp before entering the footprint to apply the articulation locking bar; four wheel chocks secured with chained D-shackles at 45 degrees.
Incident in the work area: stop work, call supervisor, gather evidence; never attempt self-recovery if bogged or bellied — JHA required first.
